prompts.rabbit:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent layered 2D animation atlas for an existing preschool visual timer.
Input Image 1 is the approved style and identity reference. Adapt ONLY the ivory RABBIT from that image into separately painted animation parts. Preserve the warm natural-history picture-book fur, realistic low horizontal animal anatomy, normal dark eye, soft pink inner ears, long hind feet and tiny cotton tail. The other animals are not part of this output.
Output composition: ONE landscape atlas, EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS by THREE ROWS of equal invisible cells. Genuine transparent background. Each of the following twelve isolated parts stays entirely inside its assigned cell, centered with a generous transparent margin. No grid, cell borders, labels, text, shadows, checkerboard or extra marks. Do not assemble neighboring parts together.
ROW 1 left to right: (1) horizontal torso/haunch ONLY, no head, no ears, no tail and NO legs or feet, with soft overlapping rounded shoulder/hip sockets; (2) right-facing rabbit head and muzzle ONLY, no ears, no neck/body, natural dark eye; (3) one long upright near ear, pink interior, base at bottom; (4) one matching upright far ear, base at bottom.
ROW 2 left to right: (5) small cotton tail; (6) ONE hind upper thigh, long vertical softly tapered furry segment with rounded top/bottom, proximal joint at TOP, distal joint at BOTTOM; (7) ONE hind lower leg, vertical furry segment, knee at TOP and ankle at BOTTOM; (8) ONE long hind paw pointing RIGHT, ankle attaching near left third, level sole.
ROW 3 left to right: (9) ONE front upper leg, straight vertical segment, shoulder at TOP/elbow at BOTTOM; (10) ONE front lower leg, straight vertical segment, elbow at TOP/wrist at BOTTOM; (11) ONE front paw pointing RIGHT, level sole; (12) complete small right-facing rabbit in a calm four-paw standing pose, all four paws present and distinguishable, for selection icon only.
Every part has completed fur edges and rounded covered ends to overlap during joint rotation, no exposed flesh/bones, no mechanical joints. Keep ALL leg segments oriented straight DOWN, not diagonally, because the existing two-bone animation rig supplies joint angles. The torso MUST NOT contain residual legs. Consistent lighting and fur color across parts; painterly realistic fluffy texture as in the reference, no flat vector shapes, no clothes, no human hands or upright human posture. This is an animation asset, not a diagram.
